# Prompticon

> Prompticon is a free, open-source (MIT) Chrome extension that adds a customizable quick-reply toolbar above the composer in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral Le Chat, Qwen Chat, Meta AI and DeepSeek. It is 100% client-side: no analytics, no trackers, no network calls, and a single storage permission.

Prompticon is developed by QAInsights (https://qainsights.com).

## Facts

- Version: 1.3.0
- Price: free
- License: MIT
- Type: Chrome extension, Manifest V3
- Permission: storage only
- Shortcuts: Alt+1..9 insert the first nine replies, Alt+P opens the command palette
- Profiles: General, Developer, Writer, Student, Support, Recruiter, Sales, Quiz (all editable)
- Other features: draggable toolbar with per-site position memory, long-press variants, template variables like {{topic}}, opt-in local-only smart question detection, fill-for-review or send-on-click
